name: elm-klar-tools
description: Development tools for the Klar Elm package. The package itself has no npm dependencies; see elm.json.

scripts.check:format: elm-format --validate src/ tests/ example/src/ recipes/ template/src/ calendar/src/ calendar/tests/
scripts.check: npm run check:text && npm run check:css && npm run check:classes && npm run check:icons && npm run check:docs && npm run check:ai-docs && npm run check:ai-names && npm run check:recipes && node scripts/check-doc-examples.mjs --strict && npm run check:api && npm run check:format && npm test && npm run build:example && npm run check:example-imports
scripts.format: elm-format --yes src/ tests/ example/src/ recipes/ template/src/ calendar/src/ calendar/tests/ && node scripts/check-text.mjs --fix
